$comment: Degradation registry (#511 Part A). Machine-readable INDEX of every graceful-degradation mechanism in ARS: what fails, what degraded state is emitted, where the degradation is visible, who consumes it, and how the terminal-policy layer treats it. The registry INDEXES — it never re-authors: each row's `authority` points at the per-mechanism source of truth (a content anchor that must appear verbatim in the cited file), so semantics live in exactly one place and this file cannot drift into a second authority. Rows use each mechanism's NATIVE semantics (unresolvable / not_checked / PASS WITH NOTES / omit-field / warn-and-continue); there is deliberately NO universal score-cap column — ARS's gate model is tri-state outcomes + advisory suffixes + opt-in terminal policies, not a shared scalar score (#511 'Explicitly rejected: score capping'). Numeric/severity caps appear only where a scale already exists (see compliance_non_sr_warn_cap). Adding a row: fill every required field, cite the authority file with a short verbatim anchor (never a line number — anchors survive drift, line numbers do not), list the tests/lints/schemas that pin the behavior under `pinned_by` (path, or path::test_function), then run scripts/check_degradation_registry.py.

mechanisms.failure_class: Bibliographic lookup API unreachable (network error, 5xx, rate-limit exhaustion) during citation-existence verification
mechanisms.degraded_state: Per-resolver outcome status 'unreachable' (queried_by null); a TOTAL outage of all applicable resolvers reduces lookup_verified to 'unresolvable' — never to 'true' (an outage is not evidence of existence) and never alone to 'false' (an outage is not fabrication evidence)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: resolver_outcomes.<resolver>.status == 'unreachable' in the citation verification summary
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: pipeline_orchestrator_agent finalizer (5-cell gate) and terminal_policies.citation_existence evaluation
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: advisory by default; under citation_existence='strict' only lookup_verified=='false' (ID-keyed unmatched, C-V6(a)) refuses — 'unresolvable' from outage is NEVER blocked

mechanisms.failure_class: Lookup API (Semantic Scholar / OpenAlex / Crossref / arXiv) degraded while computing a contamination signal at ingest/backfill time
mechanisms.degraded_state: The per-resolver *_unmatched field is OMITTED from contamination_signals — never set to false (which would falsely read 'checked and clean'); the omission is excluded from the k/k_max triangulation count per R-L3-2-C
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: contamination_signal_omissions.<signal> == 'api_degraded' on the corpus entry (#511 Part A reason-provenance; entries written before this field exists carry no marker — absence of BOTH the signal and the omission reason is indistinguishable from 'not yet computed', which is the pre-#511 live weakness this field closes)
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: pipeline_orchestrator_agent finalizer advisory-suffix matrix (k, k_max) per shared/references/firm_rules.md R-L3-2-C
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: advisory by default per R-L3-2-A; a degraded lookup is excluded from the k/k_max count (R-L3-2-C) and which annotation tier fires is determined by the resulting (k, k_max) pair — degradation can therefore change the tier — strengthen it, weaken it, or leave it unchanged — never monotonically weaken it; whether any tier is promoted to a terminal block is decided at the emission boundary by terminal_policies (opt-in strict, contamination_triangulation only), never by the omission itself

authority.anchor: None means OMIT the field from the
Absent fields are excluded from the count and do not default to either `true` or `false`.
By default, contamination and temporal-integrity signals never block emission on their own

mechanisms.failure_class: No multimodal/vision capability available for VLM figure verification (or figure too simple to warrant it)
mechanisms.degraded_state: VLM verification step is SKIPPED; the Figure Package records 'VLM verification: skipped' instead of a verification section
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: 'VLM verification: skipped' note in the Figure Package output
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: integrity_verification_agent Stage 4.5 Phase C3 figure/table fidelity review
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: no terminal policy exists for VLM; a skipped verification can reach PASS WITH NOTES but never converts to FAIL on absence alone (FAIL requires a positive fidelity finding)

authority.anchor: If not available or figure is simple: skip (note "VLM verification: skipped" in Figure Package)
an entry reaches PASS WITH NOTES only when NO FAIL condition is met

mechanisms.failure_class: A submission-package check cannot run (missing artifact, unreadable input, extraction failure) during package verification
mechanisms.degraded_state: Check status 'not_checked' (distinct from pass AND from fail); process exit code 3 = 'passed what was checkable' — distinct from a full pass (0) and from a failure (1)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [NOT-CHECKED] lines + not_checked_count in the verification report header; exit code 3
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: submission-package policy evaluation (advisory vs strict) and the orchestrator invoking scripts/verify_submission_package.py
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: advisory: not_checked surfaces but does not refuse (exit 3); under strict, ONLY strict_eligible not_checked checks fail closed (VERIFICATION-INCOMPLETE token, exit 4) — heuristic-classed not_checked stays nonterminal at exit 3 even under strict

authority.anchor: return 3  # "passed what was checkable" (§8) — distinct from a full pass
Fail-closed (§5.2): a missing parser/profile must not silently

mechanisms.failure_class: Transport-level failure of a CONFIGURED cross-model verifier mid-run (API error, rate limit, expired key). An unset ARS_CROSS_MODEL is NOT a degradation — it is the standard single-model configuration and produces no error marker or disclosure
mechanisms.degraded_state: Warn-and-continue: pipeline proceeds single-model; NEVER blocks on cross-model transport failure; a NOT_SEARCHED grounded-lookup result is NOT a transport failure and does not fall back (it is counted separately and surfaced for re-run/human review)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [CROSS-MODEL-ERROR: reason] log line + required report disclosure 'Cross-model verification was configured but unavailable for this run. Results are single-model only.'
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: integrity_verification_agent (Stage 2.5/4.5 sample checks), devils_advocate reviewers, blind disagreement checkpoints (#518)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — cross-model is verification-support, not a gate; its absence is disclosed, never blocking

authority.anchor: Continue with single-model verification — never block the pipeline on cross-model failure
Cross-model verification was configured but unavailable for this run. Results are single-model only.
A `NOT_SEARCHED` result is **not** a transport failure and is handled differently.

mechanisms.failure_class: Compliance checkpoint running outside systematic-review mode (PRISMA-trAIce scope not applicable)
mechanisms.degraded_state: RAISE principles-only evaluation with severity capped at 'warn' — never block (the one registry row with a severity cap, legitimate because compliance already has a native block>warn>info scale; NOT a precedent for score caps elsewhere)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: compliance section of the FULL checkpoint dashboard showing principles_only / warn-only evaluation
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 2.5 / 4.5 integrity gates aggregating compliance decisions via max_severity precedence
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: non-SR compliance findings can warn but never block the pipeline; block conditions are SR-mode-only

authority.anchor: | Non-SR mode | RAISE principles_only, warn-only (never block) | Same |

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' re-review with the original (pre-revision) manuscript absent from the input manifest: the MADE_WORSE discriminators (per-item and the protocol-level generic P2 one) compare against the original text (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: MADE_WORSE is assignable only where the diff/apply report supplies the pre-revision span; elsewhere it is unevaluable and the verdict follows the remaining criteria — never guessed
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [MADE-WORSE-UNEVALUABLE: no original manuscript]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 3' decision derivation (B1/B3/B5 MADE_WORSE operands) and the Stage 3' checkpoint reader
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — visible degradation marker, never a block; the manifest's required set stays revised_manuscript + revision_roadmap only

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' escalation exception requires an original-manuscript evidence anchor (proving the problem existed in Round 1), but the original manuscript is absent (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: The exception cannot be substantiated; the underlying new_standard stays advisory — the goalpost-guard override path is closed rather than weakened
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ESCALATION-UNSUBSTANTIATABLE: no original manuscript]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 3' decision derivation Step 3 (no floor contribution) and the Stage 3' checkpoint reader
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — the escalation path fails toward advisory, never toward a fabricated floor

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' Phase 2A change_summary with BOTH of its sources absent: no original manuscript AND no apply report (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: change_summary is written from the revised manuscript alone; the required field stays total on the degraded path (schema does not hard-fail)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [CHANGE-BASIS-ABSENT: no original manuscript, no apply report]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 3' verdict records (Phase 2A) and the Stage 3' checkpoint reader
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — visible marker on the affected records, never a block

authority.anchor: [CHANGE-BASIS-ABSENT: no original manuscript, no apply report]

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' new-issue provenance cannot be established (original manuscript unavailable, non-comparable formats, manifest gaps) (#576 §8/SD-9)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Attribution 'indeterminate' — treated as previously_missed for decision purposes (cannot escalate the decision), never silently promoted to regression
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ATTRIBUTION-INDETERMINATE]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 3' decision derivation (goalpost guard — indeterminate never appears in Step 2) and integrity_verification_agent at Stage 4.5 (consumes indeterminate records as gate input)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — fail-closed on attribution, decision-inert by design; on the no-original path EVERY new issue is indeterminate

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' with the Editorial Decision Letter absent from the input manifest: the criterion inheritance chain loses its level-2 (letter Acceptance-criteria) layer (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: The §4 chain runs without level 2 — inherited_criterion.letter_text legitimately absent on every item; verification proceeds on the Schema 7 verification_criteria + remaining layers
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [CRITERIA-LAYER-ABSENT: no decision letter]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Phase 1 pre-commitment records and check_re_review_synthesis.py letter-binding invariants
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — the letter is not hard-required; the run-level marker plus the existing 'unknown (provenance block absent)' Judge Record rule make the absence visible

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' with the letter PRESENT but its Required Item Details block ids not exactly the contiguous sequence R1..Rn against the roadmap's must_fix order — a gap, duplicate, or extra id makes the #576 §5.1 ordinal derivation unsound
mechanisms.degraded_state: The WHOLE letter criterion layer degrades to absent (every item legally omits letter_text/letter_item_ref); the checker RECOMPUTES the contiguity state from the hash-bound letter + roadmap — no carrier field exists
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [CRITERIA-LAYER-ABSENT: letter/roadmap ordinal mismatch]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Phase 1 pre-commitment records and check_re_review_synthesis.py letter-binding invariants
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — a malformed letter degrades the layer visibly rather than producing a possibly-wrong join or an abort

authority.anchor: a violated sequence degrades the whole letter criterion layer

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' with the Round-1 review findings (Schema 6 reports) absent from the input manifest: the criterion chain's level-3 driving-finding layer has no report-side source (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Level 3 degrades to the Schema 7 TRANSPORTED fields alone (severity/anchor/confidence ride on the roadmap items themselves, #574 A2/A3) — partial coverage survives
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ROUND1-FINDINGS-ABSENT]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Phase 1 pre-commitment operationalization and the driving_severity operands of the decision derivation
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — transported fields keep the derivation sound; a null driving_severity on a legacy item is treated as NOT critical, never fabricated

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' with the Response to Reviewers absent: acknowledgment_only commitments (whose evidence IS the letter) cannot be independently confirmed (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Phase 2B runs claim-matching-empty (authors_claim = "—"); acknowledgment_only commitments keep their author-declared fulfillment_status UNCHANGED (the closed Schema 11 enum gains no value) but each affected commitment carries the report-level advisory flag; the existing COMMITMENT_GAP rule applies unchanged
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [COMMITMENT-EVIDENCE-ABSENT: acknowledgment_only — no response letter]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Commitment Ledger Verification output (re-review report) and the revision-loop reader
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — advisory flag; the P1 authors_claim requirement is satisfied by the letter-absent "—" fill (its flag-as-CANNOT_VERIFY consequence is legacy-mode-scoped, #576)

mechanisms.failure_class: An apply report predating format 1.2 carries no patch_digest, so the #576 §11 content-binding between the report and its paired revision_patches[] entry cannot run (cross-version chains are normal — early rounds from a pre-upgrade emitter)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Content-binding recorded as NOT-RUN for that report; its hash-chain links are still checked, no digest is fabricated, no abort fires
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [PATCH-BINDING-ABSENT: report format < 1.2]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: check_re_review_synthesis.py apply-chain witness notes and the Judge Record Apply-report chain line reader
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — a missing binding is a visible per-report note; only a CHECKED link that BROKE aborts (manifest_hash_mismatch)

authority.anchor: `patch_digest` (report format 1.2: full 64-hex sha256 over the exact patch-file bytes applied

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' verifier routing: a routed P1/P2 item's first non-DA label found no card seat, or a non-empty source_reviewer parsed to zero recognized tokens (parse failure) — partial card parsing, even when other cards parsed fine (#576 §10)
mechanisms.degraded_state: The affected items route to EIC; the run-level Routing line is the parameterized degradation form whose payload names every label group and unparsed item — a decision-driving item silently defaulting to EIC cannot hide behind a healthy-looking run
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ROUTING-DEGRADED: unmapped labels — <payload>] (payload grammar: seat-missing `<label> (<item ids>)` groups in label order, then `unparsed <item_id> "<raw>"` groups)
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Judge Record Routing line + Schema 6 judge_record.routing_status (oneOf pattern form — the payload is accountability content, never collapsed to a bare enum)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — routing degradation is visible, never a block; card_mapped is reportable ONLY when every routed item's first non-DA label found its seat

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' verifier routing: Round-1 cards are present but no non-EIC label parsed anywhere — total card-parse failure (#576 §10)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Routing defaults to EIC-verifies-all; yardstick continuity may still hold (a run can reuse cards for the yardstick AND fail to parse them for routing — the Routing line is orthogonal to Reviewer configuration by design)
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ROUTING-DEGRADED: cards unparsable]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Judge Record Routing line + Schema 6 judge_record.routing_status (constant form)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — visible total-failure form, never a block

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' verifier routing with no Round-1 Reviewer Configuration Cards available at all (#576 §10)
mechanisms.degraded_state: The existing [YARDSTICK-REGENERATED] fallback governs configuration; routing defaults to EIC-verifies-all
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [ROUTING-DEGRADED: no round-1 cards]
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Judge Record Routing line + Schema 6 judge_record.routing_status (constant form)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — visible; composes with the yardstick-regeneration advisory rather than replacing it

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' (or standalone) re-review explicitly run under ARS_RE_REVIEW_LEGACY=1 — the pre-contract single-pass orchestration shape (#576 §12/SD-8)
mechanisms.degraded_state: One-call legacy run, old template; NO traceability sidecar is produced; no byte-equivalence claim is made for LLM prose (the flag preserves ORCHESTRATION shape only). Absent the flag, a run that cannot satisfy the contract prerequisites ABORTS with the specific G0-class reason — never a silent legacy fallback
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: [LEGACY-NO-CONTRACT] at the top of the Verification Review Report
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: Stage 3' checkpoint reader; integrity_verification_agent at Stage 4.5 (sidecar absence is a visible degradation to note, not a block)
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none — legacy is explicit opt-in; the fail-closed boundary is on the FLAGLESS path (G0-class abort), not on the flagged one

mechanisms.failure_class: Stage 3' apply-chain witness with a link that cannot be CHECKED (as opposed to a checked link that broke): apply_reports empty (legitimate outside-toolchain revision) or original_manuscript absent (first link unverifiable) (#576 §11)
mechanisms.degraded_state: Closed composite states not_run_no_reports (zero reports — never a silent vacuous pass) and first_link_not_run (inner + last links still checked), under the declared total precedence; only 'fail' (positive breakage evidence) aborts
mechanisms.diagnostic_marker: apply_chain_witness == 'not_run_no_reports' | 'first_link_not_run' in DecisionInputs and on the Judge Record Apply-report chain line
mechanisms.downstream_consumer: check_re_review_synthesis.py (witness compared on every emission kind) + Schema 6 judge_record.apply_chain_witness
mechanisms.terminal_policy_effect: none for the not-run states — absence markers outrank nothing; 'fail' outranks both (fail > not_run_no_reports > first_link_not_run > pass) and is the G0 manifest_hash_mismatch abort, which is fail-closed by design
